verdict.rationale: Mastra is a framework that also offers a hosted deployment target (Mastra Cloud), so a data-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use policy. Model routing to 90+ providers and the guardrails feature do not address whether user data is used for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
